title: Import process
key_points: To import assets in Godot, place your assets directly in the project folder.
Godot will automatically import certain file types and create a .import file for each imported asset.
Use Resource Loader to access imported assets through code; use FileAccess class for non-imported files.
Changing import parameters is only possible for non-native Godot resource types.
Selecting multiple assets allows changing import parameters for all selected assets at once.
limitations: Import parameters are not available for Godot's native scene and resource file formats (e.g. .tscn, .scn, .tres, .res).
Automatic reimport only works for imported files; manual copying of non-imported assets cannot be undone.
The .godot/ folder containing imported assets should not be committed to version control, as it requires more space and bandwidth.
asserts: Importing certain file types in Godot automatically creates a hidden .import file that stores import settings for use by the Resource Loader and FileAccess classes.
